Chapter 6.5, Metering Systems for Loading and Unloading Marine Bu Carriers, First Edition, July 1980 (ANSI/API MPMS 6.5-1980)

Carriers, First Edition, July 1980 (ANSI/API MPMS 6.5-1980) This chapter deals with the operation and special arrangement of meter provers, manifolding, instrumentation, and accessory equipment used for measurement in loading and unloading marine bulk carriers. 6 page Price each, $4.0
